Actual site values are required. Complete the response fields and identify controlled schedule/diagram references. Unknown or unsupported items remain blocking for their affected scope.

<!-- SOURCE-BLOCK ET:27 END -->

<!-- SOURCE-BLOCK ET:28 BEGIN -->

Baseline and related records: [RA §5](../../architecture/reference/5-physical-fabric-and-platform-attachment.md#RA_s_005)  •  [NET §6](../../engineering/fabric/6-management-paths-and-interface-handover.md#NET_s_006)

<!-- SOURCE-BLOCK ET:28 END -->

<!-- SOURCE-BLOCK ET:29 BEGIN -->


<a id="source-table-29"></a>

| Record / decision | What to enter | Working response |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Site/failure map | Actual rack/power/uplink/control/storage fault groups and facility evidence. | {{ET\_SITE}} |
| Equipment/BOM | Model, quantity, support, firmware, capacity, optics and license references. | {{ET\_BOM}} |
| Port/cable schedule | Both device/port endpoints, speed/media, role, label and redundancy. | {{ET\_PORTS}} |
| Fabric topology | Leaf/spine or alternate, host attachment/multihoming and border design. | {{ET\_FABRIC}} |
| Management/OOB | Actual independent interfaces, permitted targets and recovery path. | {{ET\_OOB}} |
| Installation/staging | Approved qualified-personnel procedure, acceptance checks and shipment/asset receipt. | {{ET\_STAGE}} |

<!-- SOURCE-BLOCK ET:29 END -->
